text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY INSULATION RESISTANCE LOSS CHECK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY INSULATION RESISTANCE LOSS CHECK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The removed service plug must always be carried in a pocket of the responsible worker or placed in the tool box during the procedure to prevent the plug from being connected by mistake.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never allow workers other than the responsible person to touch the vehicle containing high voltage parts. To keep others from touching the high voltage parts, these parts must be covered with an insulating sheet except when using them.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Never  bring  the  vehicle  into  the  READY  status  with  the  service  plug  removed  unless  otherwise instructed in the Service Manual. A malfunction may occur if this is not observed.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: The following diagnosis procedure must be performed when 'P0AA6 or P33E1' are detected and Li-ion battery is judged that its insulation resistance is dropping.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: It is used, when replace a malfunction module.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: 2.CHECK INSULATION OF FRONT MODULE STACK LH-1
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Check that high voltage harness and harness shield have no scratches and cracks. If any damage is found, replace damaged parts.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery. Refer to EVB-194, "Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove Li-ion battery controller. Refer to EVB-214, "LI-ION BATTERY CONTROLLER : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove bus bar that connects front module stack LH and front module stack RH.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Measure voltages between positive terminal of front module stack LH and battery pack ground, and between positive terminal of front module stack LH and battery pack ground.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY INSULATION RESISTANCE LOSS CHECK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY INSULATION RESISTANCE LOSS CHECK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove bus bar that connects service plug and front module stack LH from service plug switch bracket.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Using insulation resistance  tester,  measure insulation resistance between service plug switch terminal and service plug switch bracket.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Unlike the ordinary tester, the insulation resistance tester applies 500 V when measuring. If used incorrectly, there is the danger of electric shock. If used in the vehicle 12V system, there is the danger of damage to electronic devices. Read the insulation resistance tester instruction manual carefully and be sure to work safely.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Be sure to set the insulation resistance tester to 500 V when performing this test. Using a setting higher than 500 V can result in damage to the component being inspected.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Check resistance without disassembling service plug switch and service plug switch bracket.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: YES >> Replace bus bar that connects service plug and front module stack LH and GO TO 8.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace  service  plug  switch  (Refer  to  EVB-217,  "BATTERY  JUNCTION  BOX  AND  BATTERY HARNESS : Exploded View".) and GO TO 8.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove front module stack LH. Refer to EVB-239, "FRONT MODULE STACK : Removal and Installation".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Measure voltages between terminal / of all modules in front module stack LH and module body.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY INSULATION RESISTANCE LOSS CHECK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace  malfunctioning  module  (Refer  to  EVB-246,  "FRONT  MODULE  STACK  :  Disassembly and Assembly".) and GO TO 8.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Measure insulation resistance between terminal / of all modules in front module stack LH and module body.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Unlike  the  ordinary  tester,  the  insulation  resistance  tester applies 500 V when measuring. If used incorrectly, there is the danger  of  electric  shock.  If  used  in  the  vehicle  12V  system, there is the danger of damage to electronic devices. Read the insulation resistance tester instruction manual carefully and be sure to work safely.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Be sure to set the insulation resistance tester to 500 V when performing  this  test.  Using  a  setting  higher  than  500  V  can result in damage to the component being inspected.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: YES >> Check insulation resistance of front module stack RH, because front module stack LH is normal. GO TO 8.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: NO >> Replace  malfunctioning  module  (Refer  to  EVB-246,  "FRONT  MODULE  STACK  :  Disassembly and Assembly".) and GO TO 8.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: 8.CHECK INSULATION OF FRONT MODULE STACK RH-1
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Measure voltages between positive terminal of front module stack RH and battery pack ground, and between positive terminal of front module stack LH and battery pack ground.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY INSULATION RESISTANCE LOSS CHECK
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: 9.CHECK INSULATION OF FRONT MODULE STACK RH-2
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Disconnect vehicle communication harness connector of front module stack RH.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Measure voltages between positive terminal of front module stack RH and battery pack ground, and between positive terminal of front module stack RH and battery pack ground.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: >> Replace vehicle communication harness of front module stack RH and GO TO 14.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: 10.CHECK INSULATION OF FRONT MODULE STACK RH-3
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Remove bus bar that connects front module stack RH and battery junction box.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Measure voltages between positive terminal of front module stack RH and battery pack ground, and between positive terminal of front module stack RH and battery pack ground.
text_elements.label: list_item
